score_interpretation: Editorial judgments of English-package readiness under the nine Luban weights. These are not human blind-review results, model benchmarks, measured English-user comprehension, or evidence of better scientific artwork.

dimensions.name: Runtime behavior
evidence: Independent reruns: both packages passed 22/22 unit tests with no skips and 3/3 fixture evaluations. All seven assertions per fixture passed, including source unchanged, all bound colors updated, geometry unchanged, and transparent recolored render.

The two core scripts scripts/asset_tool.py and scripts/codex_reference.py are byte-identical across baseline/candidate; the three palette.json files and all six existing SVG/PNG files are also byte-identical.
Pipette evaluation reports 6 named groups, 21 bindings, and geometry digest ed0f082168bf4da27dd5bf736c5f3ea6c6efba5b184f92cbcd102c7b6452431b in both versions.
dimensions.limitation: Equal runtime score deliberately reflects preservation, not improvement. No live image request, fresh drawing run, human science review, or editor import/edit/reopen was performed; those optional or broader claims receive no credit.

dimensions.name: Negatives and boundaries
evidence: Baseline already prohibits unsupported anatomy/mechanisms, complete flowcharts, embedded PNG delivery, and unauthorized attachment instructions.

dimensions.limitation: Boundaries are instruction and fixture evidence; this is not an adversarial security audit.

caveats: No blocking regression found within English identity/comprehension and preservation scope.

Installation and final report/card were excluded from the independent score. After the checks, the parent reported successful candidate isolation installation and five command walkthroughs; that report was not independently rerun or counted here.
README first-screen comprehension was an editorial reading check, not a measured 10-second human test.

The walkthroughs are explicitly dry_run. Actual runtime probes covered deterministic tools and recorded fixtures only; no network, image model, credential read, installed helper execution, or editor workflow was used.
Scores do not establish superior images, scientific correctness, public-release readiness, or model-routing quality. The runtime dimension remains equal.
